newsitem.title: UK: Italy's Eni tenders to sell crude, products reserve.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Eni tenders to sell crude, products reserve.

text.p: State Italian energy group Eni on Friday tendered to sell crude, gas oil and gasoline from national strategic reserves.
Eni requested bids for 100,000 tonnes of Saudi crude loading May 6-8 fob Priolo and 105,000 tonnes loading May 21-23 fob Milazzo.
It also offered four 17,000 tonne shipments of leaded gasoline loading between May 6 and May 30 fob Gaeta.
It said 25,000 tonnes of 0.05 percent gas oil were available loading June 2-6 fob Gaeta.
Small quantities of diesel, heating oil and gasoline were offered for stock transfer at Volpiano and Ravenna between April 28 and June 24.
Eni said bids must be made to its representative Sogesco SpA by April 14.
